## [Model]{.en}[模型]{.zh}

::: {.en}
::: {.placeholder}
- Score players 1–5 on: approval experience, fills CDEG gaps, needs CDEG, current opening, conflict risk, foreign-partner sensitivity; adjustable weights
:::
:::

::: {.zh}
::: {.placeholder}
- 按以下维度打分（1–5）：审批经验、补足集团短板、对集团的需求、当前机会、竞争冲突、对外资敏感度；权重可调
:::
